title: Celestin, the Imperial and her husband's two drum sets
summary: Celestin and Manuel Perez's Imperial at Slidell, her husband keeping a drum at the Cadillac, John Marrero, and drummer Oylos Trepagnier.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Imperial, yeah, the imperial. And used to give constructs over there and balls, you know, in Slidell. And what you call them, Celestine would come out there and everything. And the man, I was about 10 years old. And Yaron got to be a, of course, he's been dead a couple of years. But he really held out good. And he wanted me to let you come to him and take some lessons. He had offered to give you lessons, you know, free of charge, you know. When we lived on libertarian. Quite a few offers, you know. He had plenty of opportunities, you know, with great musicians, of course. Oh, like the fast pitch, you know. Because I'll play with him a lot, you know. Oh, all the pitch, you know. You see what all used to play with Celestine? Well, he was doing that time at the Cadillac and he had two drums. He used to leave one at the Cadillac. And then John Morero used to play a guitar with him. And so he was sent his drum by John and he'd keep on at the Cadillac. So John said, but I know, how do you know if your wife's going to be home? Oh, she's always home. She don't go anywhere. So when John come up with it, he said, I know I'll say you was going to be home, Mr. Pass. I said, yeah, but I'm going to fool him one of these days. I said, he's always sending somebody home. I said, go home. My wife's always home. So I said, one day he's going to come and be mistaken and I'll be gone, you know. So sure enough, John comes to bring the drum. He had two sets. He used to leave one at the Cadillac and then when he'd go play a picnic, then he'd have that other. And you know what you call him? That was another great musician. How about with Dodd? He was a handsome fellow, too. That drum player, Oylos Trepanion.

Yeah. Oylos played a lot of times in his job. You know, at night, he would come ass on to go play. You know, sometime, one time I think he was playing at that about three times a week. And he used to go play in Oylos Trepanion's place, you know, sometimes. I don't remember him, eh? So...
